card.name: The ending -able in chewable tablets
card.fires_on: The final piece "able" of the word chewable, right after "chew", when it describes a tablet form in drug labels.

modes.label: Chewable tablet form
modes.description: The word chewable completes right after a drug name or strength and before the word tablet.

card.plain: It fires on the last part of the word "chewable" when a label names a chewable tablet.
